title: Khaemenes Academy Preschool Physical Education — Movement Scope and Sequence
note: This map supports lesson planning and observation. It is not a medical or developmental diagnostic tool and does not make a child demonstrate a movement that feels unsafe or uncomfortable.

learningStrands.label: Balance, body awareness, and comfortable mobility
Gentle object control and visual tracking
Warm-up, cool-down, hydration, rest, and safe choices

evidenceRules: Participation record confirms that the learner completed or explored the activity.
Learning-check record documents the learner's response to a brief safety or movement question.
Adult observation records what was observed during this activity; it is not inferred from lesson completion or a quiz answer.
A different participation pathway, pause, or decline is valid context and must not automatically be treated as failure.
